name: Julius Krein

lean.basis: Ran the pro-Trump blog Journal of American Greatness and voted for Trump.

Launched American Affairs in February 2017 to give Trumpism "intellectual heft", then in August 2017 wrote in The New York Times "I Voted for Trump and I Sorely Regret It". Calls himself a conservative and nationalist (not a white nationalist) and critic of Reaganomics; now an industrial-policy advocate.

current_role: Founder and editor of American Affairs; president of the New American Industrial Alliance
summary: Julius Krein (born 1986) is a Harvard-educated former finance worker (Bank of America, Blackstone) who co-ran a pro-Trump blog in 2016 and in February 2017 founded American Affairs, a quarterly meant to give the Trump movement intellectual weight. After Charlottesville he publicly repudiated Trump in The New York Times. He now promotes industrial policy, including an American sovereign wealth fund, and spoke at NatCon in 2019 and 2021.
